images.filename: Mornigstar Mill and DeCew Falls, St. Catharines, Ontario, Canada.jpg
images.caption: This is a photo of the turbine shed (left) behind the grist mill at the Morningside Mill. The turbine is powered by water from the pond above DeCew Falls as it falls through a penstock to the turbine. Across from the mill and turbine shed is a reconstruction of the sawmill that once was part of the site. The sawmill was powered by its own turbine.
images.alt: This is a photo of the turbine shed (left) behind the grist mill at the Morningside Mill. The turbine is powered by water from the pond above DeCew Falls as it falls through a penstock to the turbine. Across from the mill and turbine shed is a reconstruction of the sawmill that once was part of the site. The sawmill was powered by its own turbine.
